t: This Luceco FType Essence Fixed Fire-Rated LED Downlight delivers efficient, dimmable cool white illumination for various interior spaces. Ideal for electricians installing lighting in kitchens and bathrooms, its IP65 rating and Zone 1 suitability provide excellent protection in damp environments. Installation is simplified with a toolless SpeedFit housing connector and loop-in/out piano key terminals, accommodating both solid and stranded cable. QuickView windows ensure correct and secure wiring, while the integrated LED driver and removable white bezel offer a sleek, finished look.
